title: Sterilizing world physics so others can't catch up

tellings.quote: One possibility is that one of the reasons we kicked all of the Americans out of our physics programs and science programs is that we wanted to sterilize the world so that it didn't catch up to us what we'd already done.

plain: The United States may have deliberately weakened physics and science programmes, "kicked all of the Americans out" of them in his words, to "sterilize the world" so that no one else could catch up to what it had already achieved in secret. A researcher named Eric Weinstein offers this on the show as one possibility, without naming a source. If true, the slowdown in physics would be a cover for hidden advances.
